 Sarah Osterbind , Meteorologist
 Delaney Willis , Meteorologist
 Jeff Haniewich , Chief Meteorologist
 Published:  November 12, 2026 at 12:52 PM Tags:  el niño , winter , snow , ice , wsls , 10 news , weather authority Every year, as winter approaches, one question seems to be on everyone’s mind: How much snow are we going to get? 
 This year is no exception! In fact, with the strong El Niño conditions we’re experiencing and expect to continue, there may be even more uncertainty surrounding the upcoming winter season.
 In this year’s Winter Weather Special, we’ll break down what El Niño could mean for our winter, tackle some common winter weather myths , explain how we forecast different types of winter precipitation, and, of course, reveal our highly anticipated 2026–2027 Winter Snowfall Forecast! 
 Our goal is to help you feel informed, prepared, and ready for whatever winter has in store. When impactful winter weather does move into our area, whether it’s snow, ice, or dangerous cold, we will issue Weather Authority Alert Days to help keep you one step ahead.
 Let’s get ready for winter together!
